master_match.note: Correlation on changing cloud pixels across expected real-time phase, not static-background similarity.

visual_findings: Received cloud positions visibly advance at 3, 6, and 9 seconds and follow the new master's expected 15-second cycle across the 120-second recording.
No abnormal long background stop was detected by the 2fps phase-correspondence screening. Exact image equality alone was not used as proof of motion.

Actual face pixels show narrow closed lids at 11.4 and 67.4 seconds, arched smiling eyes at 32.4 and 92.6 seconds, lowered/closed-eye shapes at 44.6 and 104.6 seconds, and open eyes at 20, 60, and 100 seconds.

At 15.2 seconds the mascot sits lower than its usual position. The cause is not established by this video audit. Parent reports existing greeting/changeover motion in unchanged server HTML; this is not classified as a new background defect.
limits: Independent agent inspected decoded frames and time-series correspondence, not continuous normal-speed playback.
Sub-half-second rendering stalls and the comfort of long continuous viewing are not proven by the 2fps background sampling.
